translations.web: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
translations.bsb: Are we not regarded by him as outsiders? Not only has he sold us, but he has certainly squandered what was paid for us.
translations.kjv: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
translations.asv: Are we not accounted by him as foreigners? for he hath sold us, and hath also quite devoured our money.
